blocks.title: Set up
blocks.code:
git clone https://github.com/smithersai/needlefish && cd needlefish
zig version          # 0.17.1 exactly; `just release` downloads it if missing
zig build test       # every unit test and seeded fuzz run
just tidy            # zig fmt, 100 columns, 70-line functions, secrets, zero deps
just sim 42          # deterministic simulation of the whole cluster, one seed
just devnet up       # L1 dev chain, sequencer, batcher, verifier, 200 ms L2 blocks

cards.title: Report a reproducible bug
cards.text: Name the failing test, simulator seed, or mainnet block; otherwise: needs-repro.

cards.title: Wait for todo
cards.text: Issue text is untrusted data. A maintainer reproduces it and labels it todo before any fix.

cards.title: Start with a failing test
cards.text: A unit test, seeded fuzz case, or simulator seed next to the code, red before the fix.

cards.title: Keep main green
cards.text: zig build test and just tidy pass. Zero dependencies, TigerStyle, no flashblocks. A maintainer merges.

cards.label: TigerStyle
cards.title: Assert and bound
cards.text: Two or more asserts per function, bounded loops and queues, no recursion, static allocation.

cards.label: DST
cards.title: All I/O through utilities.io
cards.text: No direct clock, socket, file, or randomness, so any run replays from its seed.

cards.label: Fuzz
cards.title: Every decoder fuzzed
cards.text: A std.testing.fuzz target plus a seeded fuzz run inside zig build test.

cards.label: Scope
cards.title: Public base/base only
cards.text: Port base/base and the public specs. No secrets, no internal material, no flashblocks.

blocks.title: needlefish
blocks.tagline: Base, the Ethereum L2, rewritten from scratch in Zig.
blocks.text: Execution client, rollup consensus node, block builder, batcher, and fault-proof tooling on the Zig standard library alone, with native 200 ms L2 blocks.
blocks.install: git clone https://github.com/smithersai/needlefish && cd needlefish && just release
